name: skip-link
title: Skip Link
description: The "jump to main content" link that satisfies WCAG 2.4.1 (Bypass Blocks): an `sr-only` anchor that pops into the top-left corner the moment it takes focus, letting a keyboard user step past the header and nav in one Tab.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/skip-link

Installed to `components/ui/skip-link.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/skip-link';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/skip-link

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
